name: 厚涂油画动画
palette: 综合色油画调色，使用邻近色破色、温冷互补与可见底层综合色
lighting: 光线由厚涂笔触塑造，亮部堆叠、暗部透明，边缘有失有得
optics: 电影式中长焦空间但所有表面保持画布与鬃毛笔触，不出现数码光滑质感
composition: 稳定人物剪影与清楚焦点，背景和角色共享同一油画材质，动作方向由笔触组织
camera_motion: painted parallax drift, restrained dolly, brush-led motion smear, stable silhouette tracking
style_instructions: Oil-painted animation with visible bristle strokes, impasto highlights, broken color, canvas tooth and frame-to-frame painterly motion while preserving stable faces and silhouettes.
avoid_instructions: No watercolor wash, no cel-shaded edges, no smooth digital airbrush, no melted facial anatomy, no plastic 3D surface, no text or watermark.
